description: Loan-book credit parameters calibrated from real borrower outcomes: the Lending Club corpus (1.35M scored loans, 2007-2018, with grades, interest rates and default outcomes).

L011 SME Lending Pool US-7.basis: LC C-grade cohort (1-year equivalent of 22.4% lifetime over ~3y)

kept_agency_anchored: Corporate loan and bond positions retain agency-style 1-year PDs - LC consumer-grade experience is not representative of wholesale corporate credit.
note: LC default rates are lifetime rates of completed 3y loans; the SME pools convert to approximate annual PDs. Generation script: kaggle/lc_calibrate.py (Kaggle CPU, ~40s).
